extracted.name: Yumm snacks NAMAKPARE
instruction_lines: Mix all the dry ingredients well.add oil and make a hard dough by adding slowly water.keep it in warm place by covering for 2 to 3 hours
Make oil hot at medium heat and take small balls of dough.flatten them and give any shape.deep fry at medium low flame until crisp golden.keep it for 7 to 10 days.yumm homemade snacks are ready.
